title: microsorum ensatum var. phyllomanes
intro: Microsorum ensatum var. phyllomanes, commonly known as Phyllomanes, is a type of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Asian medicine, particularly in China and Southeast Asia, for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Phyllomanes include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides.
